draft.title: The Sustainable Development Goals and health
card: The Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) are 17 global goals adopted by United Nations member countries in 2015. They aim to be met by 2030.
Goal 3 is about health. It aims for good health and wellbeing for all people, at every age.
Other goals also shape health. Goal 1 is no poverty, Goal 4 is quality education, and Goal 6 is clean water and sanitation (safe toilets and waste disposal).
These goals link together. Progress on one can improve health even when it is not a health goal, such as clean water cutting the spread of disease.
draft.remember: Goal 3 targets health directly, and goals on poverty, education and water also affect health.

a.q: Which goal is the SDG that aims for good health and wellbeing for all?
opts: Goal 3
Goal 1
Goal 4
Goal 6
a.why: Goal 3 is the health goal. Goal 1 is about poverty, Goal 4 is about education and Goal 6 is about clean water and sanitation. These affect health but are not the health goal itself.
a.clue: Look for the goal that names health in its aim.

b.q: A village builds safe toilets and a clean water supply, and cases of diarrhoeal disease fall. Which SDG is most directly being met, and how does it link to health?
opts: Goal 6, which improves health by cutting disease spread
Goal 3, which improves health by funding more hospital beds
Goal 1, which improves health by raising family incomes
Goal 4, which improves health by teaching hygiene
b.why: Clean water and sanitation is Goal 6. Safe water and toilets cut the spread of disease, so a goal that is not about health still improves it. Goal 3 is tempting because health improved, but the village's actions were about water and toilets, not health care.
b.clue: Match the action the village took to the goal that names it.

b.best: Goal 6, which improves health by cutting disease spread

problems.detail: Why (b) says the village's actions were about water and toilets 'not health care', implying Goal 3 is about health care. The card describes Goal 3 as good health and wellbeing for all, and Goal 3 itself includes cutting disease and deaths from unsafe water. Better to say Goal 3 is the health outcome goal, while the action itself falls under Goal 6.
